findings.title: Proposition 1/C1 is false as stated
findings.impact: The paper overclaims a universal continuous-domain veto theorem beyond the finite grid actually checked.
findings.reproduction: Set f(s)=s1+s2+s3 and tau=2.5 on [0,1]^3. f(1,1,1)=3 is admissible; with any coordinate 0, f≤2, so no vetoed profile is admitted.
findings.follow_up: Retract or weaken the universal proposition, or add a condition ensuring a vetoed profile can meet the threshold.

findings.title: Proposition 4/C5 cannot reconstruct records or substitution provenance from Evidence Set alone
findings.impact: The lineage claim is materially stronger than the emitted evidence supports.
findings.reproduction: Inspect any substituted remediate-regate line: it contains a post-remediation evidence_id and numeric substituted_value, but no original bytes/metadata or buffer-write provenance. Hashes are not reversible.
findings.follow_up: Store immutable content/provenance objects or durable resolvable references for original and remediated evidence, or weaken the claim to identity commitment.

findings.title: Theorem 1 iff corollary has an unproved and generally false necessity direction
findings.impact: The paper treats gate invariance as necessary for single-pass soundness without an executability/reachability condition.
findings.reproduction: Let authority vary under rho only for actions independently held by DQ. Those actions never execute, so single-pass can remain sound despite non-invariance.
findings.follow_up: State only sufficiency, or add and prove explicit universal reachability/executability assumptions.

findings.title: CH1 post-hoc audit does not re-evaluate exact executed evidence
findings.impact: The zero-violation claim is weaker than its DQ wording suggests.
findings.reproduction: composition._audit_clean_evidence_record rebuilds a clean governed-buffer record from action values; audit_executed uses that synthetic record rather than the execution evidence/metadata.
findings.follow_up: Persist and audit the exact Phase-II evidence or a lossless canonical representation.

findings.follow_up: Replace placeholders with verified citations before release.

findings.title: Exact scipy t-intervals exceed the protocol 1e-6 tolerance for two endpoint pairs
findings.impact: Displayed paper rounding is unaffected, but the stated exact-tolerance audit criterion is not met.
findings.reproduction: Recompute with scipy t(df=29): CH2 divergent endpoints differ by up to 1.085566964e-6 and CH5 max-violations endpoints by up to 3.767356247e-6 because sweep.py uses rounded T_CRIT_DF29=2.045230. All other intervals are within tolerance.
findings.follow_up: Compute the critical value from scipy (or relax/document the tolerance for the rounded constant).
